image_description: An open, soft-sided carpenter's tool roll or pouch containing various hand tools. Visible items include a spirit level, a tape measure, pliers/cutters, and several screwdrivers with wooden handles arranged in pockets. Three additional screwdrivers with wooden handles are lying on the white surface in the foreground. The background features blurred green foliage.

artifact_observations.location: Labels on the spirit level and tape measure
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the green spirit level vial and the yellow tape measure casing is illegible scribbles, mimicking text structure but lacking readable characters. This is a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Wooden handles of the foreground screwdrivers
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood grain texture appears slightly smudged and overly smooth, lacking the fine micro-details of real wood. The transition between the metal shaft and the handle is somewhat soft.

artifact_observations.location: Metal tips of the foreground screwdrivers
artifact_observations.reasoning: The tips of the screwdrivers in the foreground appear slightly bent or fused with the shadow/background. The geometry of the flat-head tips is not perfectly crisp.
The bokeh effect on the grass is uniform but lacks depth variation, appearing like a flat texture map rather than optical blur.
